item.title: Poland mourns six killed in Krakow shooting; terrorism probe launched
item.description: Poland has begun two days of national mourning after a gunman killed six people in central Krakow on Saturday, in what authorities have described as a terrorist attack. item.title: Berkshire Hathaway buybacks surge to $9.6 billion in Q3 as earnings decline
